query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_mentors, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN verificationStatus = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approved_mentors,
       SUM(CASE WHEN verificationStatus = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_mentors,
       SUM(CASE WHEN verificationStatus = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rejected_mentors
FROM mentor_profiles;
